name: Frost Thrall
definitionRules: Summon a 20 HP / 7 Power Thrall. Attacks apply 1 Chill.
rules: Summon Frost Thrall: 20 HP / 7 Power. Attacks apply 1 Chill. Rot starts at 1. Automatically spend Corpses equal to its Mana cost instead if available.
displayRules:
Summon a Thrall. 20 HP / 7 Power.
Attacks apply 1 Chill.
Rot starts at 1.
If you have 2 Corpses, spend them instead of Mana.
